newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Tadiran unit in pact with Trak of the U.S..
newsitem.headline: Tadiran unit in pact with Trak of the U.S..

text.p: Elisra Electronic Systems Ltd, a subsidiary of Tadiran Ltd, said on Sunday it had signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Trak Microwave of Tampa, Florida.

Under the agreement each side will be permitted to manufacture and market synthesiser products developed by the other for civilian and defence applications. The technologies include DLVA and LOG-IF products, switches as well as DRO, VCO and CRO microwave sources.
Hai Ben-Yisrael, Elisra's director for microwave products, said the agreement would enable the two sides to offer better products at lower prices.

Elisra, with 1996 revenues of $95 million, makes electronic warfare systems, microwave components and other products. It has an orders backlog of approximately $200 million. Trak, a maker of microwave systems and sub-systems, has annual revenues of around $31 million.
